scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.prisma:dev: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:safe:dev: npm run prisma:format && npm run prisma:validate && npm run prisma:dev && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:safe:deploy: npm run prisma:format && npm run prisma:validate && npm run prisma:deploy
scripts.prisma:status: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma migrate status
